maria_s: heads up — my flight got delayed, need someone to cover a short window today 18:00-22:00 PT. It's low-risk but we have a scheduled model rollout at ~19:00 PT and I'd like someone to watch the deploy and warm caches. runbook snippet below. :plane:

alex_k: I can take 18:00-20:00 PT if that helps. haven't seen anything flaky in the canary this morning. can you paste the prewarm commands?

maria_s: awesome, thanks @alex_k. quick notes: traffic should be light but watch latency and any queue backpressure. if you see errors, fallback to model-small via routing policy. runbook: ```
# quick checks for the rollout
curl -sS https://internal-api.redwood/health | jq . 
# check canary status
curl -sS https://control-plane.redwood/api/canaries/rollouts/123/status 
# prewarm kv cache for model
redwoodctl prewarm --model rwd-llama-13b --concurrency 4 --duration 60s
# warm embedding cache (if used)
redis-cli -h cache.internal lrange prewarm_queue 0 50
```

alex_k: perfect. I'll run the prewarm ~18:30 PT and monitor the canary. what's the expected success metric for the canary?

maria_s: aim for <1% error rate and p99 latency within +50ms of baseline. if p99 jumps >200ms or errors >1% for 5m, abort the rollout and switch traffic to model-small. abort command: `redwoodctl rollout abort 123`

oncall-bot: scheduled_deploy_notice: Deploy 123 (rwd-llama-13b -> v2.1) scheduled at 19:00 PT — initiated by ci-bot

jordan_p: I can pick up 20:00-22:00 PT and do the handback. alex, want me to standby for the abort step if needed?

alex_k: yes please, that'd be great. ping me in this thread when you take over. I'll add a short note to rotation doc. :thumbsup:

samuel: FYI I already pushed a tiny canary yesterday (0.2%) — logs here https://ci.redwood/reports/rollout-123. no anomalies besides a transient 502 at 03:12 PT that resolved after a retry.

maria_s: thanks everyone. I'll DM creds for a temporary console session to @alex_k. Logging: I'll append this handoff to the oncall-rotation doc and mark the window. If anything critical happens, tag #incidents and call the escalation list.

alex_k: copied. quick checklist I'll follow: run prewarm, validate canary metrics, watch queue depth, watch redis and gpu memory, have abort ready.

jordan_p: noted. I'll be ready at 20:00 PT and leave a short handback message when I take over. gl!

maria_s: thanks all — appreciate the help. I'll try to get to the gate but will stay reachable until handoff is complete. :pray:
